english: Now Saul was consenting to his death. At that time a great persecution arose against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except the apostles.
chiru: Khanikhan Jerusalem biekrup chung a epshawna lientak `khat hawngshok joi. Tirtawn hai niboia, takashawn kholok kha Judea le Samaria ram ah rurethehmashak joi.

english: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.
chiru: Khan richichawi miring hai na Stephen kha rukhum ua, ama chung a mulung jumna runiei uh.

english: As for Saul, he made havoc of the church, entering every house, and dragging off men and women, committing them to prison.
chiru: Inia Saul na tu in rikip ah lut a biekrup kha mupuhok a ruthaw, khan nupang apa jet boi a lungroko shung ah rukai a rukhum joi.

english: Therefore those who were scattered went everywhere preaching the word.
chiru: Khajarkhan retherak miring hai kha na munmun ah rushe ua athachawng kha rushem uh.

english: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria and preached Christ to them.
chiru: Philip na Samaria ah rushe a amani dieng Christa kha rurophong.

english: And the multitudes with one accord heeded the things spoken by Philip, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.
chiru: Philip na iruthaw jetna hai kha rujet a rumuk u phakhan, mipui na ama chawngriei kha mulungluttak a rurangaishom uh.

english: For unclean spirits, crying with a loud voice, came out of many who were possessed; and many who were paralyzed and lame were healed.
chiru: Ajarla raikho rono hai kha na ra`ailam a, aniei miring tampui ah put ah, vak shok uh, khan takthi ninawkle kekhawr miring tampui kha rumadam.

english: And there was great joy in that city.
chiru: Khajarkhan kha khopui khan ningaina lientak `khat ruawm joi.

english: But there was a certain man called Simon, who previously practiced sorcery in the city and astonished the people of Samaria, claiming that he was someone great,
chiru: Khalaikhan makha khopui shung khan matienglai a dawileai chon thaw, Simon iti miring `khat ruawm. Ama na ibibing a alien `khat kanih, tia, Samaria miring hai kha shinrumawdawng pe uh.

english: to whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.
chiru: Ashinalien mi kholok na Hi miring hi Pathien ranak alien kha keng, tia mulunglut a rurangai uh.

english: And they heeded him because he had astonished them with his sorceries for a long time.
chiru: Ama dieng mulungluttak a irurangaina u ajartu, pha shawttak mahi dawileai hai hi le shinirumawdawng pe u inih.

english: But when they believed Philip as he preached the things concerning the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, both men and women were baptized.
chiru: Inia amani na Pathien rengchangna jar a le Jesu Christa riming chungchanga chawng rushem, Philip kha takarushawn u phakhan, nupang apa dire na baptisma ruloi uh.

english: Then Simon himself also believed; and when he was baptized he continued with Philip, and was amazed, seeing the miracles and signs which were done.
chiru: Simonshe kha na`awm takarushawn joi. Khan ama na baptisma ruloi shole, Philip le chatboi a rurawtawp joi, khan ranakniei chon le jetna hai kha rumuk phakhan, shinrudawng pe.

english: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,
chiru: Khan Samaria miring hai na Pathien chawng kha loi u joi, iti chawng kha Jerusalem ah awm tirtawn hai na rujet u phakhan, Peter le John kha amani dieng rutir uh.

english: who, when they had come down, prayed for them that they might receive the Holy Spirit.
chiru: Idi hai kha na rushe ua, takashawn `thar hai na Ratha Riethieng tumna u rang, runik pe uh.

english: For as yet He had fallen upon none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
chiru: Ajarla Ratha Riethieng na amani `khat diengshe jong maklai. Amani na Pumi Jesu riming ranga kha le baptisma iruloi u nilai.

english: Then they laid hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
chiru: Khashole Peter le John na amani chung ah khut rutet pe ua Ratha Riethieng kha rutum u joi.

english: And when Simon saw that through the laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Spirit was given, he offered them money,
chiru: Khan tirtawn hai khut kha amani chung ah atet shole, Ratha Riethieng irupek kha Simon na rumuk phakhan, amani dieng shier rupek.

english: saying, Give me this power also, that anyone on whom I lay hands may receive the Holy Spirit.
chiru: Khan ama na ruti, Tukhat chung ah khut hai hi katet `le, Ratha Riethieng muknathiei rang, kiei diengawm mahi cham hi nepeh u roh.

english: But Peter said to him, Your money perish with you, because you thought that the gift of God could be purchased with money!
chiru: Inia Peter na ama dieng ruti, Pathien khutchawi hi shier pek a mukthiei, tia nangmining jarkhan, nang shier hi nang le athangchen nih rosho!

english: You have neither part nor portion in this matter, for your heart is not right in the sight of God.
chiru: Mahi chonmun hin tum ninawkle roiruputna niei makche, ajarla nang mulung kha Pathien maikung a dik mak.

english: Repent therefore of this your wickedness, and pray God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.
chiru: Khajarkhan mahi ashie ah put ah mulung lek tana Pathien dieng nikna niei roh. Khanitatu nang mulung na ikhin kha rangaidam pekthiei rangnih.

english: For I see that you are poisoned by bitterness and bound by iniquity.
chiru: Ajarla mulung akha na inubuk khan dikna boi thirakarui na inokhop kha kiei na kumuk.

english: Then Simon answered and said, Pray to the Lord for me, that none of the things which you have spoken may come upon me.
chiru: Simon na mashang a ruti, Nangiti hai kholok kha kiei dieng shokna boi rang, kiei rang Pumi dieng ninik pe roh.

english: So when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem, preaching the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.
chiru: Tun Peter le John na kungruchangsho ua, Pumi chawng kha rushemsho u `le, Jerusalem ah rukir u joi. Khan lam ah athachawng kha Samaria miring hai kho tampui dieng vak shem u joi.

english: Now an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, Arise and go toward the south along the road which goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is desert.
chiru: Khashole Pumi ravantir na Philip dieng ruriei, Thoi roh, khan thang tieng she tana Jerusalem ah put ah Gaza tieng shena lamshuk ramthim lam kha rawh roh.

english: So he arose and went. And behold, a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace the queen of the Ethiopians, who had charge of all her treasury, and had come to Jerusalem to worship,
chiru: Khajarkhan Philip na thoi a rushe joi. Khan enro, chamnieitak Ethiopia eunuch `khat ruawm. Ama kha Ethiopia miring hai rengnu Candace niei`in kholok apana runih. Ama na Jerusalem ah Pathien bieh rushe inih.

english: was returning. And sitting in his chariot, he was reading Isaiah the prophet.
chiru: In tieng rukirna ama shakawr gari chung ah shutlam a thiempulien Isaiah behangbuk kha rute a ruawm.

english: Then the Spirit said to Philip, Go near and overtake this chariot.
chiru: Khashole Ratha na Philip dieng ruti, Jawng tana shakawr gari khaw vak dep roh.

english: So Philip ran to him, and heard him reading the prophet Isaiah, and said, Do you understand what you are reading?
chiru: Philip na rutan a ama na thiempulien Isaiah behangbuk irute a ruawm kha vak rangai phakhan, rurawdawn, Nangite kha nangjet maw?

english: And he said, How can I, unless someone guides me? And he asked Philip to come up and sit with him.
chiru: Ama na ruti, Mi `khat na lamnakai pe nawkala, itia maw kiei na jet ngam ning? Khan Philip kha hawng lut a hawng shutna rang, ama na rudawi.

english: The place in the Scripture which he read was this: He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; And as a lamb before its shearer is silent, So He opened not His mouth.
chiru: Ama na irute Miejiek khala hi inih: That rang a ichawi kengam ang a, khan moeppa maikung a a`awmchien kengamte kha ang a, ama na bai rumakak mak.

english: In His humiliation His justice was taken away, And who will declare His generation? For His life is taken from the earth.
chiru: Ama redena khan, ama dikna kha loi pe joi. Tu na maw ama chicha hai jar a rophong nih? Ajarla rieliei ah put ah iringkho kha loi pe joi.

english: So the eunuch answered Philip and said, I ask you, of whom does the prophet say this, of himself or of some other man?
chiru: Eunuch na Philip dieng ruti, Nawrawdawn rawng, thiempulien na tu jar a iriei maw nih, ibibing jar a maw nih ninawkle tu `khat chungchanga iriei maw nih?

english: Then Philip opened his mouth, and beginning at this Scripture, preached Jesus to him.
chiru: Khashole Philip na ener rumakak a mahi miejiektak hin ah put ah Jesu chungchanga athachawng kha rurophong pe joi.

english: Now as they went down the road, they came to some water. And the eunuch said, See, here is water. What hinders me from being baptized?
chiru: Khan amani na lam kha ivakrawh u le roroia, tui awmna mun `khat ruawm, khan eunuch na ruti, Enro, hin tui awm joi, kiei baptisma ninomoloi rang hin tu na maw namakha nih?

english: Then Philip said, If you believe with all your heart, you may. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.
chiru: Khan Philip na ruti, Nang mulung kholok le takanangshawn a tu, nangthawthiei. Khan ama na mashang a ruti, Kiei na Jesu Christa hi Pathien Shapa kha inih, iti hi takakawshawn.

english: So he commanded the chariot to stand still. And both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water, and he baptized him.
chiru: Shakawr gari kha dingna rang chawng rupek a, Philip le eunuch adin u tui awmna tieng khan ruchum uh, khan ama na baptisma rupek joi.

english: Now when they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, so that the eunuch saw him no more; and he went on his way rejoicing.
chiru: Amani na tui ah put ah hawng shok phakhan, Pumi Ratha na Philip kha ruchawi joi. Eunuch na ama kha rumulai mak, khan ama na ningailam a rupang joi.

english: But Philip was found at Azotus. And passing through, he preached in all the cities till he came to Caesarea.
chiru: Inia Philip na Azotus khan rurumuh joi, khan Philip na khopui kholok ah athachawng kha Caesarea vak shok masheng, rushem joi.
